newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Corpgro buys Rent-A-Sign, other ad groups.
newsitem.headline: Corpgro buys Rent-A-Sign, other ad groups.

text.p: South Africa's Corpgro Ltd said on Thursday it will acquire the Rent-A-Sign group and the Inter-Africa group of companies as well as Poland's Supersigns Polska with effect from March 1.
The firm gave no details of the buys' price tag.
The financial investment holding company said in a statement that the acquisitions will form the basis of a new division to be known as Corpgro Communications.
The new media group would operate some 19,000 sites in South Africa, Sub-Sahara, Africa and Poland.

Corpgro chief executive officer Jeff Liebesman said the acquisitions were expected to have a positive effect on earnings and net asset value, details of which would follow in an announcement at a later date.
Liebesman said the rationale behind the purchase was the rapid rate of growth in the outdoor advertising industry both in South Africa and offshore.
"In this country, less than three percent of total adspend is on outdoor, as opposed to 10 percent in most overseas countries."
He said the relatively underdeveloped market in South Africa and the rest of Africa, which responded well to outdoor messages in both rural and urban areas, could be expected to boost this adspend.
The company added that it was involved in negotiations for further acquisitions in each of its business units which could affect its share price.
